{{Top}}
[[File:Luke_macros.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] using [[MB450 macrobinoculars/Legends|MB450 macrobinoculars]].]]

'''Macrobinoculars''' were handheld viewing devices that allowed users to observe distant objects. Some models were able to see into space from the surface of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Weequay_tanks_binoculars.png|thumb|left|200px|A formation of tanks is viewed through macrobinoculars]]
Macrobinoculars were small devices with two cushioned eyecups and a top-mounted rangefinder. The standard pair of macrobinoculars included an internal readout that provided information on distance and elevation, and many could record and play back images. Although macrobinoculars were designed to be used either during the day or at night, some models specialized in the latter, such as the [[Nightview macrobinoculars]] introduced by [[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]].

Macrobinoculars were similar in function to [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]], although they lacked several features such as image enhancement chips and the light-adjustment circuitry. This meant that macrobinoculars returned a truer, if less-detailed image, and were not as useful when used in the dark. However, macrobinoculars were more robust and the device's optics were harder to damage and less likely to need recalibration.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Macrobinoculars were capable of enhancing images up to a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] distant, and included zoom capability, a readout showing azimuth, range, and elevation, and a light amplifier. The unit was covered with an impact resistant casing.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

However, they were cheaper than electrobinoculars and more readily available in remote areas such as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Their resilience made them a popular choice among [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. Some macrobinoculars were worn by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] over helmet visors, often with polarized lenses.

==History==
[[File:Obiwan-binocs.jpg|thumb|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] using macrobinoculars on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].]]

Compact macrobinoculars were used by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] while on field missions across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] carried a pair of these spyglasses with him prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the attempted assassination of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], Obi-Wan tracked [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. There, he spied on a meeting between [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] and the leaders of the newly formed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the final days of the Clone Wars, Obi-Wan again used his macrobinoculars to spy on a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] meeting between [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] members in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], prior to their escape from [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].
